title: Reinforcing Few-Step Diffusion Models via Shadow Posterior Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.25998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Few-step diffusion models are widely deployed for their efficiency. However, reinforcing them with black-box rewards, as is routine for multi-step models, faces two structural challenges. First, a few-step generator is a sampler rather than a score model, so its velocity is not the forward velocity of the generated distribution. Second, it must be anchored to the undistilled teacher, which shares no transitions with it. Existing few-step RL methods handle the latter with a marginal KL to the teacher, but each pays for the former in its reward credit. We propose Shadow Posterior Matching (SPM), which renoises generated samples into shadow inputs and obtains the credit from their shadow posterior. From the KL-regularized reward objective, we derive a regression loss that turns reward values into a reward direction while anchoring the generator's outputs to the teacher and aligning the shadow inputs with the deployed inputs. Applied to 4-st

translated_title: 通过影子后验匹配强化少步扩散模型
translated_abstract: 少步扩散模型因其高效性而被广泛部署。然而，像多步模型的常规做法那样，用黑盒奖励来强化它们面临两个结构性挑战。首先，少步生成器是一个采样器而非分数模型，因此其速度并不是生成分布的前向速度。其次，它必须锚定到未蒸馏的教师模型，而二者之间不共享任何转移过程。现有的少步强化学习方法通过相对于教师模型的边缘KL散度来处理后者，但每一个方法都在其奖励信用中为前者付出代价。我们提出影子后验匹配（Shadow Posterior Matching, SPM），该方法将生成的样本重新加噪为影子输入，并从其影子后验中获得奖励信用。从KL正则化的奖励目标出发，我们推导出一个回归损失，它将奖励值转化为奖励方向，同时将生成器的输出锚定到教师模型，并使影子输入与部署时的输入保持对齐。应用于4步（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出影子后验匹配（SPM）方法，通过将生成样本重新加噪并从影子后验获取奖励信用，克服了用黑盒奖励强化少步扩散模型时采样器速度失配与教师锚定缺失两大结构性难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Shadow Posterior Matching (SPM), which renoises generated samples to obtain reward credit from shadow posteriors, resolving the structural challenges of velocity mismatch and missing teacher anchoring when reinforcing few-step diffusion models with black-box rewards.
